description: Uniform dirty-guard surface implemented by every component whose composer text lives in private fields the host cannot observe through parameters: TmActivityComments, TmChat, TmNotionBlockCommentPanel, TmNotionTextCommentPanel, TmNotionPageCommentPanel, TmNotionPageCommentSection, TmDocumentCommentComposer, TmDocumentCommentThread, TmDocumentCommentRail, TmDocumentCommentThreadPanel and TmDocumentPageViewer. Flow: poll HasUnsavedDraft (or track OnDraftChanged), ask in the CONSUMER'S OWN confirmation dialog, then DiscardDraftAsync — no implementing component shows a confirmation itself.

members.name: HasUnsavedDraft
members.description: Whether the component currently holds an unsaved draft that a reload, a navigation or a panel close would silently discard. The same aggregate value OnDraftChanged reports; read it on the component's dispatcher (an event handler or InvokeAsync) from background threads.

members.name: DiscardDraftAsync
members.description: Clears every draft slot (composer texts, open replies, open edits). A no-op — without any OnDraftChanged notification — when no editor is open and no draft exists. Call it AFTER the user confirmed the discard in the consumer's own confirmation dialog.
